performance.verdict: Meta dark 2 days; every lead and dollar stalled — restore or redirect now.

findings.text: Meta went dark Sep 12–13 (spend $0 both days), killing all leads; zero_spend_day flag confirmed. CPL spiked 168.88% on zero delivery — not efficiency collapse, it's a full stop.
7-day leads dropped 66.67% and CPL hit ~$7.40 28d avg, but the prior-3-day signal is 0 leads vs prior 3-day avg of ~1.7 — trend is total flatline, not gradual decline.
OVERDUE: 5 milestones past due (Jul 23–Aug 31): phone attribution gap, sync/contact cleanup, dashboard, and Aug scoreboard decision — all unresolved as of Sep 14.
GHL shows 92 opportunities from 341 contacts with 0 appointments won and $0 pipeline value — 249 contacts produced no opportunity, and 0 of 92 opps converted, signaling an intake or tagging failure.
GBP actions fell 38.71% week-over-week; ig_reach dropped to 2 and 1 on Sep 12–13, mirroring Meta outage — organic amplification has also collapsed alongside paid.

suggestions.text: Diagnose and restore Meta campaign delivery immediately; $0 spend Sep 12–13 means zero leads for 2+ days.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spent $0 on Sep 12 and Sep 13, dropping 7-day leads by 66.67% and pushing CPL up 168.88%. The immediate action is to identify the account-level block — payment failure, policy flag, or campaign-level error — and restore delivery today. Success is confirmed when spend resumes above $22/day (the recent daily floor) and at least 1 lead is recorded by Sep 17. If delivery cannot resume within 48 hours, escalate to Nacer and flag to Sohib as a client-trust risk given the August prove-it context.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL pipeline: 249 contacts with no opportunity created signals an intake tagging leak, not an ads problem.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 341 contacts but only 92 opportunities created, meaning 249 contacts (73%) were never tagged as opportunities; additionally, 0 of 92 opps show any won value or appointments. Ahmed/Ali should audit whether these 249 are duplicates, non-leads, or leads that bypassed the opportunity-creation step. Success is a documented count of true lead contacts versus non-lead contacts, and a corrected opportunity count, by Sep 17. This is separate from the ads performance issue and must be resolved before the dashboard milestone can be trusted.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions recovery after Meta restore; 38.71% drop may reverse once paid traffic resumes by Sep 17.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell 38.71% week-over-week and dropped to 0 on Sep 12–13, coinciding exactly with Meta going dark. No independent GBP fix is warranted yet — the organic drop is likely a downstream effect of paid traffic loss reducing profile visibility. Re-check GBP actions on Sep 17 after Meta delivery is restored; if GBP actions remain below 5/day by then, treat as an independent organic issue and escalate separately.
